title: 第19章 有人第20章 倒霉催的蒙面人

第十九章 有人
“杜大姐，我看就这些吧。”叶石嘴角有些抽搐的问道，手里拿着一张水榭客栈的点食单，看着上面的价格，叶石笑得有些勉强。
奸商啊！叶石心里暗骂，亏这水榭客栈的老板跟他说什么茶水便宜，酒菜精良，就点了这么些东西，几个金币就没了。
“叶小哥似乎有些心疼啊。”杜莺笑道。
“没有，能请到杜大姐一起吃饭，是多大的荣幸，怎么还会嫌菜贵呢。”叶石干笑几声。
“叶小哥不要怀疑，这水榭客栈的酒菜虽然贵，却是出了名的美味，想必吃过之后叶小哥就不会心疼了。”杜莺说道。
这水榭客栈能在第三街区屹立这么久，凭借的就是大厨刘光辉的一手好菜，据说刘光辉都是六品厨士了，只差一点就能够成为七品厨师，这手好菜就连城主黄海涯尝过之后都赞不绝口。
而刘光辉和水榭客栈只是合作关系，几个金币的菜钱，有七成是被刘光辉收取的。但就是剩下的三成，去掉成本价也让水榭客栈挣了不少。
人生当世，除了追求剑道巅峰，就是生活中的吃喝睡三种。最后的睡却是不难，但吃喝两项则是泛生出许多行业，其中就有厨士和酒师。
做得一手好菜，厨士哪怕不及铸剑师，却也是生活无忧，甚至只是地位不及铸剑师而已，在金钱问题上却是厨士占优。当然就像铸剑师一样，要真有本事的厨士才行，相同的酒师也一样，一个好的酒师生活不一定就比铸剑师差。
“希望吧。”叶石不在意的道，舌头上的事物叶石不是很在意，只要不难吃，能够填饱肚子的就无所谓。
不过现在整整有了几个金币换来的一餐，叶石也有了几分期待，尽管对味道要求不高，但谁也不希望花了那么多钱买来的是一些普通货色吧。
“菜来咯。”小二举着木盘走了过来，木盘上摆放着三盘菜，小二熟练的摆放在桌上，对着叶石和杜莺道：“两位老板，请稍等，剩下的菜马上就到。”
叶石点了点头，看着小二离开后，叶石才看向桌上，一盘干炒牛肉，一盘土豆烧排骨，一盘青菜。看上去三道菜色泽都不错，而且一股香味扑鼻而来，应该不差。
这时叶石看见杜莺夹着一条青菜，吃得是津津有味，心里更加信服了，便随便夹了一块牛肉放进嘴里，马上的叶石就微微的皱起眉头。
淡，一个字可以形容叶石对这牛肉的印象，这干炒牛肉果然牛肉味十足，因为除了牛肉味，其余的叶石都尝不出来。
“不会是忘记放盐了吧。”叶石嘀咕一声，夹起了另外一道菜，土豆烧排骨，结果一入口，叶石的眉头不由得皱得更紧了。
又忘记放盐了？叶石不信邪的夹了最后的一盘青菜，好吧，这时叶石的眉头总算松开了。
叶石终于确定，这不是厨士忘记放盐，而是根本没放，三道菜全部都是一个清淡，除了材料本身的味道，叶石尝不出别的来。估计后面的几道菜也是一样，叶石方向筷子，慢慢的等着。
“怎么了，你不吃吗？”杜莺疑惑的看向叶石。

“没事。”叶石摇了摇头，一切等后面的菜来了再说，至于现在，就先这样子吧。
其实如果只是菜味道不够，叶石不会计较那么多，但错就错在水榭客栈坑了他这么多钱，结果拿出这样的货色出来，叶石当然有种上当的感觉。从来只有他忽悠人，这时竟然有人明目张胆的忽悠到他头上来了，叶石当然不肯。
而就在叶石等着菜上齐的时候，在叶石剑坊店铺里，来了一个不速之客。身穿黑衣的蒙面人，用匕首撬开了店铺外面的门锁，悄悄的潜入了店铺里面。
由于叶石离开店铺，所以店铺系统无法提示叶石，但这并不代表着店铺系统会放任小偷的行为，在蒙面人潜入的一瞬间，店铺系统的防御便启动了。
没有经过店主许可而进入店铺的人，一律被判定为入侵者，对于入侵者，店铺系统有自身的防御。其中，修炼大堂的妙用就出现了，修炼大堂除了给店主以及客人修炼比试之外，还有一个抵御外敌的功能。
一个模糊的身影渐渐出现在修炼大堂当中，这人黑衣蒙面，与那进入前堂的蒙面人竟然长得一模一样。而这个身影出现时，双眼是闭着的，但马上的两眼便睁开，眼神略显空洞，但行动却没有半点僵硬。
此时，前堂当中的蒙面人看着那一个个隔离剑具的光膜，心里已经开始骂娘了。从没见过这样的东西，竟然完全的将剑具隔开，想要拿走任何一柄剑都办不到，哪怕凭着他剑道五品的实力，依然撼动不了半分。
“这地方看起来很诡异，而且还有种危险的气息，赶快把任务完成了离开吧。”蒙面人暗自嘀咕，但眼看着这些光膜却没有半点办法，只好将目光看向前堂连接内部的那条路。
现在，蒙面人只能到更里面去碰碰运气了，不过在刚刚要踏入通道之时，蒙面人心中突然一紧，多年的经验立刻让蒙面人知道这是遇见危险了，身体连忙的后退一步，顿时一把匕首插在了他原来站着的地面上。
蒙面人顿时一身冷汗，要不是他感觉到危险，并迅速退开，现在估计他已经死在这把匕首之下了。
然而，现在的事情还没有结束，匕首不会无缘无故出现在这里，看上去也不是什么机关，那么就只有一个解释了。
“有人。”蒙面人只剩下露在外面的双眼中，瞳孔猛然一缩。有人，而且实力不比他差，最重要的是，他在明处，而那人在暗处，这才是蒙面人真正惊骇的原因。
“是谁，出来。”蒙面人喊道，他并不期望这话能够让对方出来，但只要能够影响到对方的心态，他就能够从中感觉到蛛丝马迹，从而捕捉到这隐藏的对手。
可惜的是，那站在蒙面人不远处的‘蒙面人’目光盯着蒙面人，情绪上没有半点波动，似乎根本听不见蒙面人的叫喊一般。
“没人？”蒙面人心中疑惑，喊了一阵都不见有动静，如果真的有人不应该会这样的，难道是他猜错了，这只是一个简单的机关。
然而就在蒙面人走神的刹那，一个剧烈的危机感在蒙面人心里产生，这次比起之前更盛，蒙面人这才知道，哪里是没人，而是他没找到而已。而刚刚他走神了，被对手捉住了时机，一出手就给他带来死亡的危机。
蒙面人迅速转身，用匕首挡住了对手的攻击，尽管如此右臂上依然被划开了一道口子，对手实力不比他差，又在有心算无心的情况下，蒙面人当然负伤。
而这时，蒙面人才总算看清楚了对手的模样，然而这一眼看过去，却让蒙面人心神震撼，比起之前的都要震撼。
“你……你是？”蒙面人有些结巴的看着眼前的身影，脸上充满了不敢置信。

Chapter 19 Someone
"Sister Du, I think that's all." Ye Shi asked with a twitching corner of his mouth. He was holding an order sheet from Shuixie Inn in his hand. Looking at the prices on it, Ye Shi smiled a little reluctantly.
What a profiteer! Ye Shi cursed in his heart, because the owner of the Shuixie Inn told him that the tea was cheap and the food and wine were good, so he just ordered these things and lost a few gold coins.
"Brother Ye seems a little distressed." Du Ying said with a smile.
"No, it's such an honor to invite Sister Du to have dinner with me. How can I think the food is expensive?" Ye Shi laughed a few times.
"Brother Ye, don't doubt it. Although the food and drinks at Shuixie Inn are expensive, they are famously delicious. I think Brother Ye won't feel bad after eating them." Du Ying said.
The Shuixie Inn has been able to stand in the third block for so long because of the excellent cuisine of chef Liu Guanghui. It is said that Liu Guanghui is a sixth-grade chef and is just a little short of becoming a seventh-grade chef. Even the city owner Huang Haiya was full of praise after tasting this delicious food.
Liu Guanghui and Shuixie Inn only had a cooperative relationship. Liu Guanghui collected 70% of the food money of a few gold coins. But even the remaining 30%, excluding the cost price, made Shuixie Inn a lot of money.
In this life, in addition to pursuing the peak of swordsmanship, there are three types of life: eating, drinking and sleeping. It is not difficult to fall asleep in the end, but eating and drinking have given rise to many professions, including chefs and sommeliers.
Even if a cook is not as good at cooking as a swordsmith, his life is worry-free. Even if his status is inferior to that of a swordsmith, when it comes to money, the cook has the upper hand. Of course, just like a swordsmith, you need to be a really capable cook. The same goes for a sommelier. A good sommelier's life is not necessarily worse than that of a swordsmith.
"I hope so." Ye Shi said nonchalantly. Ye Shi didn't care much about the things on his tongue. As long as it wasn't unpalatable and could fill his stomach, it didn't matter.
But now that he had a meal in exchange for a few gold coins, Ye Shi also had some expectations. Although he didn't have high requirements for taste, no one wanted to spend so much money to buy some ordinary things.
"The dishes are here." The waiter came over with a wooden tray. There were three dishes on the wooden tray. The waiter skillfully placed them on the table and said to Ye Shi and Du Ying: "Boss, please wait a moment, the rest of the dishes will be here soon."
Ye Shi nodded. After watching the waiter leave, Ye Shi looked at the table, which contained a plate of dry-fried beef, a plate of roasted pork ribs with potatoes, and a plate of green vegetables. The three dishes all look good in color and have a fragrant aroma, so they should be good.
At this time, Ye Shi saw Du Ying holding a piece of green vegetables and eating it with relish. He felt more convinced, so he casually picked up a piece of beef and put it into his mouth. Ye Shi immediately frowned slightly.
One word can describe Ye Shi's impression of this beef. This dry-fried beef is really full of beef flavor, because apart from the beef flavor, Ye Shi can't taste the rest.
"You couldn't have forgotten to put the salt," Ye Shi muttered, picking up another dish, braised pork ribs with potatoes. As soon as he took a bite, Ye Shi's brows couldn't help but frown even more.
Forgot to add salt again? Ye Shi picked up the last plate of green vegetables without believing anything evil. Well, at this time Ye Shi's brows finally relaxed.
Ye Shi finally determined that it was not that the chef forgot to add salt, but that he didn't add it at all. All three dishes were bland, and Ye Shi could not taste anything else except the taste of the ingredients themselves. It was probably the same for the next few dishes. Ye Shi turned to his chopsticks and waited slowly.
"What's wrong, don't you want to eat?" Du Ying looked at Ye Shi doubtfully.
"It's okay." Ye Shi shook his head and waited until the next dish came. As for now, let's just leave it like this.
In fact, if the food was just not tasty enough, Ye Shi wouldn't care so much. But it was his fault that Shuixie Inn cheated him out of so much money, and when he came out with something like this, Ye Shi certainly felt like he had been cheated. neverHe was the only one who deceived others, and now someone blatantly deceived him. Of course Ye Shi refused.
And while Ye Shi was waiting for the dishes to be served, an uninvited guest came to Ye Shi's Jianfang shop. The masked man in black used a dagger to open the door lock outside the store and sneaked into the store quietly.
Because Ye Shi left the store, the store system could not prompt Ye Shi, but this did not mean that the store system would let the thief do it. The moment the masked man sneaked in, the store system's defense was activated.
Anyone who enters the store without the owner's permission will be judged as an intruder. The store system has its own defense against intruders. Among them, the magical function of the training hall appears. In addition to allowing the shop owner and guests to practice and compete, the training hall also has a function of resisting foreign enemies.
A vague figure gradually appeared in the training hall. This man was dressed in black and masked. He looked exactly like the masked man who entered the front hall. When this figure appeared, his eyes were closed, but they opened immediately. His eyes were slightly hollow, but his actions were not stiff at all.
At this time, the masked man in the front hall looked at the light films that separated the swords and began to curse in his heart. I have never seen anything like this before. It actually completely separated the swords. It was impossible to take away any sword. Even with his fifth-level swordsmanship, he still couldn't shake it even half a point.
"This place looks very weird, and it also has a dangerous atmosphere. Please complete the task and leave as soon as possible." The masked man muttered secretly, but seeing these light films there was no way he could do anything, so he had to look at the road connecting the front hall to the interior.
Now, the masked man could only try his luck further inside. However, just when he was about to step into the passage, the masked man's heart suddenly tightened. Years of experience immediately told the masked man that he was in danger. He quickly took a step back, and suddenly a dagger was inserted into the ground where he was standing.
The masked man suddenly broke into a cold sweat. If he hadn't sensed the danger and quickly retreated, he would have died under the dagger by now.
However, the matter is not over yet. The dagger will not appear here for no reason, and it does not seem to be a mechanism, so there is only one explanation.
"There is someone." Only the masked man's eyes were exposed, and his pupils shrank suddenly. There is someone, and the strength is not inferior to him. The most important thing is that he is in the light, and that person is in the dark. This is the reason why the masked man is really frightened.
"Who is it? Come out." The masked man shouted. He did not expect that these words would make the other party come out, but as long as it could affect the other party's mentality, he would be able to sense clues and capture the hidden opponent.
It's a pity that the 'masked man' standing not far away from the masked man stared at the masked man without any fluctuation in his mood, as if he couldn't hear the masked man's scream at all.
"No one?" The masked man was confused. He shouted for a while but there was no movement. If there is really someone who shouldn't be like this, could it be that he guessed wrong? This is just a simple mechanism.
However, at the moment when the masked man was distracted, a strong sense of crisis arose in the masked man's heart. This time it was stronger than before. Only then did the masked man realize that there was no one there, but that he had not found it. But just now he was distracted, and his opponent seized the opportunity, bringing him the crisis of death as soon as he made a move.
The masked man quickly turned around and blocked the opponent's attack with a dagger. However, his right arm was still cut open. The opponent's strength was not inferior to him, and the masked man was naturally injured because of his mental arithmetic.
At this time, the masked man finally saw his opponent clearly. However, this glance shocked the masked man, even more than before.
"You...are you?" The masked man stuttered and looked at the figure in front of him, his faceFull of disbelief.
